_comment: Every finding code and reason code the code can emit, with a plain label and severity (info | warning | critical). Sources: core models.DataQualityCode, core eval/conditions.py. Live DecisionReport has NO reason_code field yet (free-text `reasons` only) - core must add one before the UI can use these on request reports. Change this file first, then the code.

missing_field.label: A required value is missing (for example a supplier lead time).

stale_timestamp.label: Stock data was last synced too long ago.

invalid_reference.label: A record points to something that does not exist.

conflicting_quantity.label: Two records disagree about the same stock quantity.

unsupported_status.label: A record has a status TwinGuard does not understand.

invalid_action.label: The action's parameters are not valid.

permission_denied.label: This role may not propose this action.

transfer_quantity_exceeds_limit.label: The transfer is larger than the allowed maximum.

transfer_same_warehouse.label: Source and destination warehouse are the same.

purchase_budget_exceeded.label: The purchase is over the budget limit.

simulation_rule_violation.label: The simulation breaks a business rule.

all_simulations_rule_unsafe.label: Every simulated future breaks a business rule.

data_quality_finding.label: The data has a problem, so a person must decide.

serious_action_relevant_finding.label: A data problem affects this action.

simulation_stockout_review.label: The simulation shows unmet customer demand.

simulation_material_value_review.label: The action commits a large share of the budget.

unsimulatable_data_finding.label: The data is too broken to simulate.

near_capacity_under_uncertain_data.label: Warehouse may be near capacity and the data is uncertain.

possible_hidden_po_coverage.label: A purchase order may be missing from the data.

all_simulations_unsafe_with_data_finding.label: Every future ends badly and the data has problems.

simulation_outcomes_split.label: Some simulated futures are safe and some are not.

checks_passed_or_findings_unrelated.label: Checks passed; data problems do not affect this action.
